title: Common form components — approval pack
subtitle: Co-operative Corporations Act filing prototypes
purpose: This pack shows the shared UI building blocks used across the filing prototypes. Review each screenshot and the annotation table, then mark Approve, Revise, or Defer. Comments in the Decision column will guide the next prototype iteration.
forms: Form 1 — Articles of Incorporation (with share capital)
Form 2 — Articles of Incorporation (without share capital)
Form 3 — Application for Supplementary Letters Patent
Form 11 — Application for Letters Patent of Amalgamation
Form 14 — Articles of Continuance (with share capital)
Form 15 — Articles of Continuance (without share capital)

components.name: Before you begin
components.forms: 1, 2, 3, 7, 10, 11 (Forms 14 and 15 use an instructions page instead)
components.summary: Landing page before the numbered steps: form name, estimated time, what you will do, documents to gather, payment, instructions, and contact.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Before you begin.

targets.label: Lead text
targets.note: Tells the filer to review the information for this filing before starting.

targets.label: Steps in this process
targets.note: Numbered outline of the filing steps.

targets.label: Submission checklist
targets.note: Documents and information the filer should gather before starting.

targets.label: Payment
targets.note: Filing fee reminder and payment checklist. Copy differs by form; layout is the same.

targets.label: Instructions
targets.note: Navigation and save-draft guidance while completing the filing.

targets.label: Contact information
targets.note: Ministry contact for questions about the submission process.

targets.label: Continue
targets.note: Primary action into Step 1 (cover letter).

components.name: Cover letter — contact information
components.forms: 1, 2, 3, 7, 10, 11, 14 (standalone Cover letter prototype; Form 15 has no cover letter yet)
components.summary: Filer contact details, pre-filled from the signed-in account. Used if the ministry needs to reach the person filing. Not on the public record.

targets.label: Step indicator and Back
targets.note: Shows current step and returns to Before you begin.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Contact information. Same heading on every cover letter.

targets.label: Lead text
targets.note: Explains why contact is collected, that official documents are sent here, and that it is not on the public record.

targets.label: First name
targets.note: Required. Pre-filled from the signed-in profile.

targets.label: Middle name(s)
targets.note: Optional.

targets.label: Last name
targets.note: Required. Pre-filled from the signed-in profile.

targets.label: Email
targets.note: Required contact email for this filing.

targets.label: Confirm email address
targets.note: Must match Email.

targets.label: Telephone number
targets.note: Required, with optional extension.

targets.label: Continue / Cancel
targets.note: Cover letter has Continue and Cancel only — no Save as draft.

components.name: Co-operative details — type, primary activity, official email
components.forms: All eight filing forms for primary activity and official email. Co-operative type/sub-type on Forms 1, 2, 7, 10, 14, 15.
components.summary: Administrative details collected on every filing: NAICS primary activity, official email (entered twice), and (on most forms) co-operative type.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Co-operative type and contact (wording differs by form).

targets.label: Lead text
targets.note: Explains sub-type, NAICS, and official email. Not on the public record.

targets.label: Co-operative sub-type
targets.note: Optional on Form 1/2; required as Type of co-operative on Forms 7, 10, 14, 15.

targets.label: Primary activity (NAICS)
targets.note: Required. Search and select a NAICS Canada activity.

targets.label: Primary activity hint
targets.note: Expander with NAICS Canada guidance and link.

targets.label: Official email
targets.note: Required. Where the co-operative receives official documents. Not on the public record.

targets.label: Official email hint
targets.note: Explains why official email is collected.

targets.label: Confirm official email
targets.note: Must match Official email.

targets.label: Continue / Save as draft / Cancel
targets.note: Same three actions on every step.

components.name: Co-operative name and Nuans report
components.forms: Always on Forms 1, 2, 14, 15. Conditional (name change) on Forms 3, 7, 10, 11.
components.summary: Proposed or current name plus one or more Ontario Nuans reports (PDF and report date). Filers can add another report.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Co-operative name (or keep vs change name on later forms).

targets.label: Lead text
targets.note: Asks for the proposed name in block capitals and the Nuans report that confirms it is available.

targets.label: Name of the co-operative
targets.note: Required proposed or current legal name.

targets.label: Nuans report upload
targets.note: PDF of the Nuans report for this name.

targets.label: Nuans report date
targets.note: Report must be dated within 90 days of submission.

targets.label: Add another Nuans report
targets.note: Adds another PDF and date pair (up to the form maximum).

components.name: Head office address
components.summary: Ontario head office: postal-code / street lookup, then municipality, street, city, province, and postal code. Manual entry if lookup does not find the address.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Head office address.

targets.label: Lead text
targets.note: Head office must be in Ontario and set out in full. A post office box alone is not enough.

targets.label: Search address
targets.note: Type a street address or postal code. Ontario-only lookup.

targets.label: Status of municipality
targets.note: City, town, township, and similar.

targets.label: County, district or regional municipality
targets.note: Upper-tier geography for the head office.

targets.label: Street number and name
targets.note: Civic address fields after lookup or manual entry.

targets.label: Province or territory
targets.note: Ontario head office; province is selected from a list.

targets.label: Postal code
targets.note: Canadian postal code, formatted on blur.

components.name: First directors — count, rules, and list
components.summary: Board size (fixed or min/max), multi-stakeholder rules where they apply, and a summary list of first directors with Add / Edit / Remove.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Directors.

targets.label: Number of directors
targets.note: Fixed number, or minimum and maximum.

targets.label: Multi-stakeholder co-operative
targets.note: Yes/no. If yes, stakeholder director counts are required (Forms 1, 2, 14, 15).

targets.label: First directors list
targets.note: Summary cards with name, details, and Remove.

targets.label: Add director(s)
targets.note: Opens the add-director subflow.

components.name: Add director — person details
components.summary: Subflow to add or edit one director: legal name, email, residency, address for service, written consent, and on Forms 1 and 2 whether they are also an incorporator.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Add director (or Edit director).

targets.label: First / middle / last name
targets.note: Legal name. First and last required.

targets.label: Email address
targets.note: Optional contact for this director.

targets.label: Resident Canadian
targets.note: Required yes/no on Forms 1, 2, 14, 15.

targets.label: Also an incorporator
targets.note: Forms 1 and 2 only. If yes, share details are collected here and carried into incorporators.

targets.label: Residential address
targets.note: Canadian, US, or international address for service.

targets.label: Save / Cancel
targets.note: Returns to the directors list.

components.name: Incorporators — list
components.summary: List of incorporators (individuals or corporations). Directors marked as incorporators appear here automatically. Minimum 3, or 5 for a Worker Co-operative.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Incorporators.

targets.label: Lead text
targets.note: Defines an incorporator as the person who signs or authorizes the articles.

targets.label: Incorporators list
targets.note: Summary cards. Linked directors cannot be removed here.

targets.label: Add an Incorporator
targets.note: Opens the add-incorporator subflow.

components.name: Add incorporator — individual or corporation
components.forms: 1 and 2 only (Form 1 also collects shares taken)
components.summary: Subflow to add an incorporator as an individual (name, residency, address, shares) or a corporation (name and OCN search, signer, position).

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Add an incorporator (or Edit incorporator).

targets.label: Type of incorporator
targets.note: Individual or corporation.

targets.label: Individual name
targets.note: First, middle, last name when type is Individual.

targets.label: Resident Canadian
targets.note: Required for individual incorporators.

targets.label: Shares taken
targets.note: Form 1 only: number, class, and amount to be paid.

targets.label: Save / Cancel
targets.note: Returns to the incorporators list.

components.name: Membership and special provisions
components.summary: Free-text article fields for membership classes, stakeholder groups, and special provisions. Hint tells filers to enter N/A if a field does not apply.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Membership and provisions.

targets.label: Classes of membership
targets.note: Optional classes; N/A if none.

targets.label: Terms for each class
targets.note: Terms and conditions attaching to each class.

targets.label: Stakeholder groups
targets.note: If any; N/A if none.

targets.label: Stakeholder group terms
targets.note: Terms for membership in each group.

targets.label: Special provisions
targets.note: Any other articles provisions; N/A if none.

components.name: Submit — signed PDF and authorization
components.summary: Upload the signed articles PDF, confirm authorization to file, and submit. Same pattern on every form that has a submit step.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Submit.

targets.label: Lead text
targets.note: Upload the signed PDF and confirm authorization to file.

targets.label: Upload signed PDF
targets.note: Signed copy of the generated articles.

targets.label: Authorization
targets.note: Checkbox confirming the filer is authorized to submit.

targets.label: Submit / Save as draft / Cancel
targets.note: Submit replaces Continue on this last step.

components.name: Registry details callout (existing entity)
components.summary: Read-only Ontario Business Registry details (legal name, OCN, incorporation date) shown above editable primary activity, official email, and type of co-operative.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Business details.

targets.label: Lead text
targets.note: Review registry details, then update NAICS, official email, and type of co-operative. Not on the public record.

targets.label: Co-operative details callout
targets.note: Read-only legal name, Ontario corporation number, and incorporation date from the registry.

targets.label: Primary activity
targets.note: Same NAICS field as new-incorporation forms; may be pre-populated.

targets.label: Type of co-operative
targets.note: Required dropdown on Forms 7 and 10.

components.name: Amalgamating co-operatives / corporations — list
components.forms: 10 (Form 11 list and add actions are C17–C19)
components.summary: Same add / edit / remove list pattern as directors and incorporators, used for amalgamating co-operatives. Each row has legal name, OCN, and members’ approval date.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Amalgamating co-operatives.

targets.label: Lead text
targets.note: Asks for each amalgamating co-operative’s name and the date members approved the amalgamation agreement.

targets.label: Entity list
targets.note: Summary cards. At least two amalgamating co-operatives required.

targets.label: Add amalgamating co-operative
targets.note: Opens the add-entity subflow (C16).

components.name: Add amalgamating co-operative
components.checkText: Enter the co-operative name and OCN manually
components.forms: 10 (Form 11 add actions are C18 and C19)
components.summary: Subflow to add or edit one amalgamating co-operative: registry search, optional manual name and OCN, and the date members approved the amalgamation agreement.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Add amalgamating co-operative (or Edit).

targets.label: Ontario Corporation Number search
targets.note: Search by OCN or name. Selecting a result fills legal name and OCN.

fallback.text: Enter the co-operative name and OCN manually

targets.label: Enter name and OCN manually
targets.note: Shows Legal name and OCN when the co-operative is not in the registry search.

targets.label: Legal name
targets.note: Required when entering manually.

targets.label: Ontario Corporation Number
targets.note: Required when entering manually.

targets.label: Date of members’ approval

targets.label: Save / Cancel

components.name: Amalgamating corporations — list
components.summary: List of amalgamating corporations with two add actions: the corporation on the signed-in account, or another corporation. At least two are required, and one must be the account corporation.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Amalgamating corporations.

targets.label: Lead text
targets.note: Asks for each amalgamating corporation’s name and the date shareholders or members approved the amalgamation agreement.

targets.label: Corporation list
targets.note: Summary cards with legal name, OCN, approval date, and Remove. At least two required.

targets.label: Add my Corporation
targets.note: Opens the add subflow with the signed-in account’s corporation pre-filled (C18).

targets.label: Add Another Corporation
targets.note: Opens the empty add subflow to search or enter another corporation (C19).

components.name: Add my Corporation
components.summary: Add the corporation on the signed-in account. Legal name and OCN are pre-filled from the registry; the filer confirms the date of shareholders/members approval.

targets.label: Page title
targets.note: Add amalgamating corporation (same heading as Add Another Corporation).

targets.label: Ontario Corporation Number label
targets.note: Field label. Required.

targets.label: Search hint
targets.note: Tells the filer to search by Ontario Corporation Number, or use manual entry if the corporation is not found.

targets.label: Ontario Corporation Number search
targets.note: Pre-filled with the signed-in account’s OCN and legal name.

fallback.text: Enter the corporation name and OCN manually

targets.note: Optional. Same manual-entry path as Add Another Corporation.

targets.label: Save / Cancel

fallback.text: Enter the corporation name and OCN manually

targets.label: Ontario Corporation Number
